#### When was the last earthquake in China?
A 4.5 magnitude earthquake hit near China on the afternoon of October 26, 2025 at 15:04 local time (Asia/Urumqi).
The center of this earthquake was located 75km north-northeast of Xinyuan at a depth of 10km under land.
Check the list on our website for any earthquakes occurring near China in the past hours.
#### What was the strongest earthquake near China?
A 8 magnitude earthquake hit near China on the afternoon of January 15, 1934 at 16:43 local time (Asia/Shanghai).
The center of this earthquake was located 291km southwest of Rikaze at a depth of 15km under land.
This is the strongest earthquake that occurred near China since the year 1900.
#### How often do earthquakes occur near China?
In the past 10 years, 4584 earthquakes with a magnitude of four or higher occurred within a 300 kilometer range from China.
This averages to 458 earthquakes yearly, or one earthquake every 1 days.
